description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of time related to “Efficient deployment” and “Reduction”, with a total of two slices presented. The larger slice, labeled “Reduction”, is orange and occupies approximately 69.92% of the chart, corresponding to 60.9 seconds. The smaller slice, labeled “Efficient deployment”, is blue and represents approximately 30.08% of the chart, corresponding to 26.2 seconds. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The “Efficient deployment” slice is slightly offset from the rest of the chart. A legend is not present, but the labels directly correspond to the slices. The slices are visually ordered from largest to smallest, moving clockwise.
